key.name: history-size
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned entries kept in clipboard history.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: After picking an entry, simulate a paste keypress (Shift+Insert) in the focused window. When off, the entry is only placed on the clipboard.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When enabled, new clipboard contents are not recorded to history.

key.name: popup-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the clipboard popup at the pointer. Empty disables it.

key.name: preview-length
key.description: Maximum characters shown per text entry in the popup.
